name: Roasted Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Toss the 3/4 pounds green beans with 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar until evenly coated.
Spread in a single layer and roast 20 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons grated Parmesan and serve warm right away.
